title: Jugs for the Feast

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Mrs. Hannah sent milk up the farm road this morning, for tomorrow's feast. She's walking up herself tomorrow!

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Will you fill the jugs? Each has a line, so there's enough for every table.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Fill each jug to its line. Hold the churn over a jug, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each jug to its line: a quarter, half, three quarters, and full.

feedback.too_full: Oops, over the line! Tap that jug to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Every jug filled. The tables are nearly ready!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Look at the square: tables, garland, pies and milk. Tomorrow it will be full of friends.

journal_line: I filled the milk jugs for the Harvest Home feast.
